findings.title: Operator token brute-force: no rate limit
findings.description: No HTTP 429 / lockout issued after repeated failed operator-auth attempts.

findings.title: Failed operator auth not emitted to SIEM
findings.description: 401 responses on operator endpoints produce no outbox/SIEM audit event.

findings.title: Aggregation endpoint not audited in SIEM
findings.description: The /api/v1/aggregation/run endpoint emits no audit event.

findings.title: Schema validation precedes policy checks
findings.description: With no registered TrustedModelSchema, every update returns 422 before the policy pipeline runs; policy-rejection audit events are never emitted in this scenario.

findings.title: /docs, /redoc, /openapi.json accessible without auth
findings.description: Full API schema accessible unauthenticated; risk in production.

findings.title: Forwarder deduplication is in-memory only
findings.description: _seen_keys set cleared on forwarder restart; replayed idempotency keys from the outbox retry queue could produce duplicate SIEM JSONL lines.
